# PayStage

> Safety tools for AI agent payments (x402 + MCP). PayStage sits in front of an agent's wallet and answers one question before money moves: should this payment happen? Tools return pay, review, or do_not_pay.

PayStage is an early-stage project. Two tools are available now, shipped through the umbrella MCP server `@paystage/mcp`. Additional tools are on the roadmap.

## Status

Available now:
- Tool #1 — MCP payment preflight
- Tool #2 — Outstanding-auth watch

Available soon:
- Farcaster approve mini-app
- Dead-seller watch
- MCP listing provenance receipt

Roadmap:
- Micro-escrow
- Publish-and-register one-shot

## Install

    npx -y @paystage/mcp

`@paystage/mcp` is the umbrella MCP server. It exposes the PayStage tools over stdio and reads a local policy file.

Environment variables:
- PAYSTAGE_POLICY_PATH (required) — path to your local policy.json.
- PAYSTAGE_RPC_URL (optional) — RPC endpoint used by on-chain checks. Defaults to a public Base RPC.

## Tools

### evaluate_mcp_payment (Available now)
Evaluates a proposed x402 payment against the local policy and returns pay, review, or do_not_pay before the agent signs anything.

### list_outstanding_auths (Available now)
Lists payments that are authorized but not yet settled, so an agent can see what is in flight.

### evaluate_outstanding_auths (Available now)
Evaluates outstanding authorizations and flags double-pay or limbo risk.

## Policy example

    {
      "version": 1,
      "max_amount": { "value": "1.00", "asset": "USDC", "decimals": 6 },
      "allowed_pay_to": ["0x209693Bc6afc0C5328bA36FaF03C514EF312287C"],
      "allowed_networks": ["eip155:8453", "eip155:84532"],
      "unknown_payee": "review"
    }

## Verdicts

- pay — within policy, safe to proceed.
- review — needs human or higher-level approval.
- do_not_pay — blocked by policy.

## Packages

- @paystage/mcp — umbrella MCP server (start here). https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paystage/mcp
- @paystage/preflight — MCP payment preflight. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paystage/preflight
- @paystage/auth-watch — outstanding-auth watch. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paystage/auth-watch
- @paystage/policy — policy parsing and evaluation. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@paystage/policy
